name: backdoor/attach-policy
description: Attach an IAM policy to a user or role via a GameLift game server process that reads SHARED_CREDENTIAL_FILE instance role credentials

options.name: TARGET_ARN
options.description: IAM user or role name/ARN to attach policy to (auto-resolved from caller identity if not set)

options.name: POLICY_ARN
options.description: ARN of the policy to attach (default: AdministratorAccess)
